title: RVS Calibration Experiment — Bradley-Terry Pairwise Comparison
purpose: Validate whether the RVS value weights reflect real user preferences

pairs.tests: Family photo vs thumbnail (same format, different value)
Irreplaceable vs downloadable (high value, low replaceability)
Downloadable vs irreplaceable video (same format, different replaceability)
RAW source vs processed version (photographers may differ)
pairs.note: This is a critical test: if photographers choose RAW but non-photographers choose JPG, RVS needs population-specific weights.

pairs.tests: Database vs legal document (businesses may differ from home users)
pairs.note: Population-dependent: businesses value databases, home users value documents.
This tests whether emotional impact (family photo) outweighs economic value (work project).

pairs.tests: Large file vs small but irreplaceable file
pairs.note: Both high value. Tests whether size matters when value is similar.

pairs.tests: Video vs document (different media, different value systems)
pairs.note: Close call. This tests the boundary between medium-value categories.

pairs.tests: Database vs thesis (both high value, different type)
pairs.note: Near-tie. This tests the top of the value hierarchy.

pairs.tests: Many low-value files vs one high-value file
pairs.note: Quantity vs quality. Tests whether the RVS model correctly discounts quantity.

photographers.name: Fotografos profesionales
photographers.description: Valoran RAW y fotos familiares, desprecian ISO y thumbnails
photographers.expected_bias: Will choose RAW over processed, family photos over everything else

legal.name: Estudios juridicos
legal.description: Valoran documentos y bases de datos, desprecian thumbnails
legal.expected_bias: Will choose contracts and databases over photos and videos

tech.name: Empresas de tecnologia
tech.description: Valoran bases de datos y codigo, desprecian ISO
tech.expected_bias: Will choose databases over documents, code over photos

home.name: Usuarios domesticos
home.description: Valoran fotos y videos familiares, desprecian archivos de sistema
home.expected_bias: Will choose family photos and videos over everything else

students.name: Estudiantes
students.description: Valoran tesis y documentos, desprecian thumbnails
students.expected_bias: Will choose thesis and documents over everything else
